evidence.positive: On the running app (demo-demo, 70 kg adult cases created via the admin API and launched with POST /api/app-launch), recorded 20 mL of 0.5% plain bupivacaine (100 mg, nerve block) 3 minutes before checking liposomal bupivacaine (m-bupivacaine-liposome, the product added by #4828). POST /api/cds/medication-selection returned the w-last-local-anesthetic-max-dose banner with maxDose 266 mg and the citation 'Max dose is 266 mg x 100% remaining local anesthetic dose', no a-local-anesthetic-max-dose-scan alert, and the stored evaluation details listed LOCAL_ANESTHETIC_ADMINISTRATIONS=[Bupivacaine 0.5%, 100 mg, Block] so the excluded dose still shows in the prior list. POST /api/cds/medication-dose with 266 mg at the current minute returned alerts: 0 and the log read 'Rule evaluated: a-local-anesthetic-max-dose-save -> false Given dose (266 mg) <= remaining dose (266 mg) + buffer (5 mg)'. Lidocaine scenario (row 1): 300 mg IV lidocaine 10 minutes earlier, then liposomal selection returned 266 mg full maximum and the 266 mg save returned 0 alerts. Save uses half the actual dose (row 7): with 100 mg bupivacaine 3 minutes earlier, a 200 mg liposomal save returned 0 alerts (100 <= 100) while a 150 mg save alerted 'Max remaining dose of Bupivacaine is 114 mg' (100 > 75, counted in full). Repeated as case F3 after the class restore: 90 mg bupivacaine 3 minutes before, selection 266 mg, 266 mg save 0 alerts.
evidence.negative: Row 5, outside the window: the same 100 mg bupivacaine recorded 10 minutes before liposomal selection reduced the w-last maximum to 114.38 mg and a 200 mg save alerted 'Max remaining dose of Bupivacaine is 114 mg'. Row 6, above the 133 mg stand-in: 30 mL 0.5% (150 mg) 3 minutes before reduced the selection maximum to 37.24 mg and a 266 mg save alerted with 37 mg remaining. Row 8, exclusion only for the liposomal dose: on the lidocaine case, selecting ropivacaine 0.5% fired a-local-anesthetic-max-dose-scan ('Max dose of local anesthetics has been reached') with i-last and w-last both at 0 mL, and selecting plain bupivacaine (row 2) fired the same scan alert. Row 3, lidocaine after liposomal: after recording 266 mg liposomal bupivacaine, selecting lidocaine fired the scan alert with w-last at 0 mg.
evidence.red_check: Pre-fix class swap. Compiled a copy of the shipped LASTProtocolService with liposomalBupivacaineExclusion forced to Optional.empty() (lombok logger written out explicitly) inside the container with its own javac against /app/classes and /app/libs, backed up the six shipped LASTProtocolService*.class files to /tmp, copied the pre-fix classes into /app/classes/com/guided/orci/service, restarted the container and waited for /actuator/health/readiness. Fresh case F2 with the identical inputs to F1 (18 mL 0.5% = 90 mg bupivacaine 3 minutes before): selection returned w-last maxDose 130.34 mg instead of 266, the log printed 'ruleId=w-last-local-anesthetic-max-dose, type=WARNING, body=Max dose is 130 mg.' (absent everywhere else in the log, the 90 mg amount was used only in F1/F2/F3), and the 266 mg save fired a-local-anesthetic-max-dose-save with 'Max remaining dose of Bupivacaine is 130 mg'. Reverted by copying the backup over /app/classes, verified every md5 matched the shipped build (main class 71be1e0256b9365a892de675073e1828), restarted, and re-ran as case F3: selection back to 266 mg and 266 mg save back to 0 alerts.

red_check_signature: ruleId=w-last-local-anesthetic-max-dose, type=WARNING, body=Max dose is 130 mg.
caveats: Rules were driven through the same endpoints the dosing form calls (POST /api/cds/medication-selection and /api/cds/medication-dose), not through a browser; the banner HTML and alert text were read from the API responses and the application log rather than the rendered page.

i-last-local-anesthetic never fires for the liposomal product because the nerve block route always yields a WARNING prompt; it was only exercised indirectly (it surfaced with 0 mL on the ropivacaine-after-lidocaine selection, which proves the shared calculation counted the lidocaine for a non-liposomal dose).

Demo's liposomal record displays as 'Bupivacaine' in alerts ('Reduce Bupivacaine Dose', 'Max remaining dose of Bupivacaine is ...') because its display name in the demo master list is 'Bupivacaine'; Mayo's product naming was not checked.

Every liposomal evaluation at demo logs WARN 'Unexpected concentration units for medication m-bupivacaine-liposome: mg/mL (expected %)' because the demo dosing row carries 13.3 mg/mL; harmless for mg dosing but it means no mL conversion is shown for that product. Pre-existing from #4828, not this ticket.

The save rule abstains with 'Remaining dose is 0 percent' when the allowance is already exhausted (the scan alert owns that case), so the row 8 save-time check for ropivacaine was observed as a scan alert plus save abstention rather than a save alert.
The four spec file deltas were confirmed present in the merged PR's file list only; spec content was not validated at runtime.
Pediatric selection (the stand-in becomes half the patient's weight-based liposomal maximum after OR-3032) was not exercised; all cases were 70 kg adults.

automation.assessment: Unit coverage is strong: LocalAnestheticLiposomalBupivacaineExclusionTest has a test per scenario row for each of the four rules plus boundary cases (exactly 5 minutes, same minute, stand-in vs half-actual-dose, mL conversion, multiple boluses). qa-suite has one core test (LAMD-001 in clinical-rules/local-anesthetic.spec.ts) covering plain bupivacaine save and scan alerts only; nothing touches the liposomal product. Worth locking in at e2e level is the wiring the unit tests cannot see: the demo liposomal product is selectable, its 266 mg maximum renders, and a label-permitted co-administration produces no alert while the same dose outside the window does.

LAMD-004 @supplemental: lidocaine 300 mg IV earlier, then Bupivacaine Liposome 266 mg saves without alert, then selecting ropivacaine fires a-local-anesthetic-max-dose-scan.

jira_comment:
Verdict: deploy-ready.

Positive: With 100 mg plain bupivacaine recorded 3 minutes earlier, selecting liposomal bupivacaine showed the full 266 mg maximum, a 266 mg save raised no alert, and the bupivacaine still appeared in the prior dose list; lidocaine given earlier was likewise excluded.
Negative: The same bupivacaine 10 minutes earlier, or 150 mg within the window, reduced the maximum and fired the save alert, and lidocaine still counted against a later ropivacaine or plain bupivacaine selection.
Red check: Running the app with the exclusion compiled out made the 90 mg co-administered bupivacaine cut the liposomal maximum to 130 mg and fire the save alert, and restoring the shipped class returned it to 266 mg with no alert.

Automation: Unit tests cover every scenario row for all four rules; three supplemental qa-suite tests are proposed for the demo liposomal product wiring.
